rationale: The 2.3.6 guide keeps limited IL2 for 2.0.0+, omits Agent Mode in that scope, defaults training off and fixes runtime to Splunk-hosted models. The commercial-region lead-in includes two GovCloud rows. The About guide qualifies same-region prompts by hosted model choice. The separate High SPL authoring/explanation announcement does not reconcile exact app, mode, runtime or tenant rollout.
